description:
Terminal result payload for `--json` / `--jsonl` structured output.

Capsule source-byte classes describe pre-sweep storage: complete run and pack-layer objects, including embedded indexes, but not checkpoint/history records. Shared sources count once, with active reachability taking priority.

active_pack_bytes.description: Physical bytes of currently reachable Git source objects.

cancelled.description: Whether the run was cancelled mid-sweep.

collectible_pack_bytes.description: Unreachable source bytes eligible for collection.

delete_failures.description: Number of object deletions that failed.

derived_index_objects_deleted.description: Number of unreachable v2 browse-index objects deleted or planned.

dry_run.description: Whether this was a dry-run (no mutations).

file_index_entries_deleted.description: Number of stale per-repository file-index rows tombstoned.

grace_period_pack_bytes.description: Unreachable source bytes retained by the grace period.

packs_deleted.description: Number of pack objects deleted (or would-be-deleted in dry-run).

partial_enumeration.description: Whether enumeration was partial (some LIST requests failed). When `true`, GC may not have considered all objects for collection; re-running GC after transient S3 issues clear is recommended. See finding S1-P5-1.

retained_history_pack_bytes.description: Source bytes retained only by history or other protection roots.

title: GcSummary
